//: Hand-checked corrections applied by scripts/import-wiki.mjs after reading the wiki export. Keys are quest ids. "requires" lists are added to what the importer found, "notes" is appended and "setNotes" replaces the imported note (original wording only), and "type", "region" and "verified" replace the imported value. "why" records where the fact came from and is not copied into data/.

village-project-timeless-tools.notes: The Hourglass must be upgraded first.

the-port-of-many-worlds.notes: Needs at least one of the A Rift in Time, Storybook Vale or Wishblossom Ranch expansions.
